name: synx
description: sYnX: a to-do list app with shared lists, reminders, and sync across web and mobile, built on React Router and Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && node scripts/verify-react-compiler-bundle.mjs && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config web/build/server/wrangler.json
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply synx-db --local --config backend/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply synx-db --remote --config backend/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy --config web/build/server/wrangler.json
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply PREVIEW_DB --remote --config backend/wrangler.preview-migrations.jsonc && wrangler preview --config web/build/server/wrangler.json
scripts.preview: npm run build && wrangler dev --config web/build/server/wrangler.json --persist-to backend/.wrangler/state
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:mobile: vitest run test/mobile- test/android- test/widget- test/post-build-comment test/changelog-order test/category-tag-emoji test/phone-carriers test/task-progress
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=web run typecheck && npm --workspace=backend run typecheck && tsc --noEmit
